entry.nor_reads: Full 16 MiB plus independent boot readback; a separate 4 MiB original B was archived before the first write
entry.replay: Recorded Android 05 transfer and commit followed by two simulated boots and thirteen synthetic diagnostic frames, with no Product startup marker. These frames exercise the decoder and do not identify a hardware fault.

restore.prestate: Actual 05 fault snapshot with diagnostic boot substituted and a simulated user change at 0x9a4060
restore.final_nor: Equal to the full pretrace snapshot apart from the intentionally changed user byte, which was preserved
